items.title: Security Council LIVE: Fresh attacks prompt emergency meeting on Yemen
items.summary: On the heels of reported Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia on Tuesday and the capture of another key port by the militants on Yemen’s Red Sea coast – including the seizure of eight UN vehicles from a key aid hub there – the Security Council is meeting on Thursday at 3pm in New York to discuss the latest developments.

items.title: UN chief demands Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon amid Nabatieh escalation
items.summary: The Secretary-General has condemned mounting civilian casualties in southern Lebanon and called on Israel to withdraw its forces from Lebanese territory, as fighting intensifies in and around Nabatieh.

items.title: Lebanon–Israel tensions escalate as Gaza sees major aid delivery
items.summary: Peacekeepers in Lebanon have reported a marked deterioration in the security situation along the Blue Line of separation, with Israeli forces intensifying their military footprint in violation of a landmark Security Council resolution, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Thursday.

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Addressing the legacy of Syria’s chemical weapons
items.summary: Following revelations from the UN nuclear watchdog that the former Syrian regime failed to report holding nuclear material and the discovery in May of an undeclared chemical weapons cache, the Security Council met Thursday to be briefed on the latest developments and discuss the way ahead.

items.title: Army Lasers Blast Drones, Proving Directed-Energy Weapons Are Future
items.summary: Service members assigned to Joint Task Force Southern Border used the Army Multipurpose High Energy Laser system to stop three hostile, unmanned aircraft systems deemed a threat. They were believed to be linked to drug cartels.
